deploy-bot: Starting deploy to dev (canary). tag=v1.28.3-rc4 commit=abc1234 initiator=@maya change_window=now
maya: kicking off canary to dev — will watch latency, traces, and smoke. tagging on-call.
derek: on it, i'll watch traces + apm dashboards :eyes:

olivia: quick note — minor bump p95 ~1.2s on /v1/embeddings, keeping an eye

olivia: p95 spike to ~2.8s on /v1/generate, error rate steady though :eyes: (grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/dev/d/abc123)
samir: that exceeds our canary SLO (p95 < 1s). i'd pause and consider rollback or pin.
maya: pausing rollout now. agree on pin to previous stable. initiating rollback/pin to v1.28.2
maya: pin command i'll run in k8s: ```kubectl set image deployment/api-server api-server=redwood/api:v1.28.2 --record```
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated to tag=v1.28.2 commit=fe321a2 initiated by @maya — rolling back canary
derek: running sanity smoke checks after rollback (quick traces + request path checks)
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: draining canary pods -> replacing with v1.28.2 pods -> migrating traffic back to baseline
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Env=dev. Status=success. Duration=3m45s. smoke checks: OK. p95 /v1/generate now ~0.9s
olivia: confirming on metrics side — p95 settled to 0.85s, traces look clean. will monitor for 10m
maya: thanks everyone. we'll keep the canary flagged and add a metric gate for v1.28.3-rc4 in the next attempt. logs uploaded: s3://redwood-deploy-logs/1945001234/ :thumbsup:
samir: follow-up: create a short release note line about the rollback and add the perf test to the pre-canary checklist
maya: will do — i'll add to the release notes and reopen a staging run once perf tests are in place
deploy-bot: End of thread. Full logs: s3://redwood-deploy-logs/1945001234/logs.txt
